newsitem.title: YEMEN: U.S. team in Yemen to help clear civil war mines.
newsitem.headline: U.S. team in Yemen to help clear civil war mines.

text.p: A team of U.S. experts is in Yemen preparing a report on clearing mines scattered across the Arab country since a 1994 civil war, a government official said on Thursday.
"The team carried out surveys of the minefields in the governorates of Aden, Lahj and Hadramaut and is now preparing a report for the authorities in Washington on clearing the mines," he said.
The official expressed Yemen's hope that Washington would help finance the mine removal programme.
The southern port city of Aden was the capital of South Yemen, which united with the north in 1990.
Yemen has said about one third of the estimated 66,000 mines planted during the two-month war sparked by a southern separatist campaign have been removed.
